summary: Iteration 8 (Admin Settings: share_url + gallery_visible) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASS (test_settings_iter8.py). GET /api/settings now returns both new fields with correct types (share_url:str, gallery_visible:bool). PATCH /api/admin/settings persists share_url (accepts any string incl. non-URLs, strips whitespace, empty string clears) and gallery_visible (bool). Non-clobber verified: patching only {price} preserves share_url and gallery_visible; patching only one new field preserves the other. Auth guard: PATCH without header -> 401, wrong password -> 401. Frontend: Admin login with 'puzopb' works, Settings tab renders both new cards. share-url-input, save-share-url-btn, gallery-visibility-toggle testIDs all present. Saving a share URL from UI persists (verified via subsequent GET /api/settings returning the exact URL). Toggle gallery visibility from UI persists as bool. Home screen integration verified end-to-end: with 1 uploaded gallery image + gallery_visible=true, home-gallery section renders 'Naši radovi' with the watermarked image; with gallery_visible=false, home-gallery is completely absent from the DOM after reload. home-share-btn still present on hero. Only carried-over 'shadow*' RN Web deprecation warning remains (from iter5-7).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking, carried over from previous iterations. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/admin.tsx styles.fab

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Migrate remaining 'shadow*' styles to 'boxShadow' to silence the RN Web deprecation warning (carried over from prior iterations).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Settings/SettingsUpdate models correctly add share_url:str='' and gallery_visible:bool=True with Optional fields for the update DTO. admin_update_settings only writes keys that are not None, so partial PATCH does not clobber other fields (verified in test_patch_price_does_not_clobber_share_url_and_gallery).
get_settings_doc() coerces gallery_visible via bool(...) and defaults share_url to '' — safe against legacy docs missing these keys.
admin.tsx SettingsAdmin uses optimistic toggle for gallery_visible with rollback on error (lines 1500-1514) — good UX.
admin.tsx share URL client-side validation (^https?://) matches the requirement 'only frontend validates'. Backend accepts any string as documented (verified test_patch_share_url_accepts_any_string).

index.tsx line 183: `gallery && gallery.length > 0 && settings?.gallery_visible !== false` correctly hides the section when explicitly false while defaulting to visible when settings is null/undefined.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of admin Settings + home-gallery integration flows
